UNIVEST WEALTH | DEPLOYMENT PLAN
I M M E D I AT E D E P L O Y M E N T P L A N
What happens, day by day
Day 1 · Thu 25-Sep | Cancel the SWP and old SIPs
Cancel the HDFC Large Cap SWP before its October instalment. Cancel SIPs in UTI Nifty 50 (both), SBI Large Cap, PPFAS, ICICI Next 50, ICICI Alpha Low-Vol, Mirae
Large & Midcap, Kotak Mid Cap and Nippon Small Cap. Change DSP Small Cap from ₹16,500 to ₹12,000.
Day 2–3 · Fri 26 – Mon 29-Sep | Redeem the tranche
Redeem SBI Large Cap, UTI Nifty 50, PPFAS, Alpha Low-Vol FoF and ICICI Next 50 in full, plus ₹5,00,000 from HDFC Large Cap (oldest units go out | first
automatically). Proceeds reach the bank in 1–3 working days.
Day 4–6 · by Fri 3-Oct | Deploy the lumpsum
Invest ₹38,26,013 across the nine funds on the Buy page, the same day, with Edelweiss Mid Cap last. Nothing is parked in a liquid fund.
By 10-Oct | Register the new SIPs
Register ₹1,20,000/month across ten Direct funds, with | first instalments in October.
Dec-2026 / Mar-2027 | Advance tax
Set aside about ₹95,400 for capital-gains tax. Pay it in the December and March advance-tax instalments to avoid interest.
If markets fall | Contingency
If the Nifty Smallcap 250 falls 10% or more, add a one-off | ₹1L each to Bandhan and BOI Small Cap from surplus savings. Keep SIPs running regardless.
Apr-2027 → Sep-2027 | Next tranche and review
After 1-Apr-2027, redeem the rest of HDFC Large Cap (≈ ₹5.38L) into Motilal Oswal Large & Midcap and Edelweiss Mid Cap. Review Mirae Large & Midcap and the
fund line-up in Mar-2027 and Sep-2027 with a fresh statement.
